desc:
Indonesia Driver (IDD) is back to introduce you to a next generation driving experience, with the first person perspective you're allowed to see from the inside!


Update Changelogs Revamp V0.9 [BETA]

Final Phase

-> New 10+ vehicles (26 in total)
-> New Depok extension update
-> 21 cars, 3 trucks, 2 motorcycle
-> There will be vehicles that may include gamepass to drive.
-> New Accessories (testing)
-> OEM Paint Generator (testing)
-> Mobile UI (Lights and Horns aren't available untill final release)




Put your suggestion and bug report in the group wall.
